dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: High rate of geometric narrowing from the anterior mid-back to a sharp posterior point at the peduncle region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor localized indentation on the upper-left lateral margin where the skin meets turbulent water; the right margin appears structurally continuous.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with light-blue to mid-grey tones in shadowed regions; high specular reflectance along the central ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low frequency of localized dark-pixel linear streaks appearing on the lower third of the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the high-reflectance white baseline and the grey-toned lateral shadows.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Short, high-contrast dark linear marks (scratches) clustered on the posterior dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible healed linear rake marks or epidermal scratches on the lower section of the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely prominent longitudinal dorsal ridge causing a sharp bilateral division in surface illumination.
